name: Raene's Cleansing
summary: At Lake Mystral, Krolg asks you to kill Ran Bloodtooth. Disguised by Dartol's Rod of Transformation, you can earn the uncorrupted furbolgs' trust. Krolg resents the night elves and fears the rot among his people. He wants the furbolgs to answer for their own.

sections.title: A Bitter Hermit
sections.body: Near Lake Mystral, Krolg lives apart from the others, displaced and weary. He blames the night elves' ancient pride for the ruin brought upon Kalimdor and the dark rot spreading through Ashenvale. Dartol's Rod of Transformation lets you approach the furbolgs in disguise. Krolg hates the kaldorei, yet he calls for neither slaughter nor the deaths of innocents.

sections.title: Policing Their Own
sections.body: Krolg believes his people must answer for their own deeds instead of yielding to the demonic taint gripping the tribes. The corruption did not give them their flaws; it magnified their worst impulses. Ran Bloodtooth shows the danger. Ruthless and hungry for power even before the taint, the chieftain embraced the darkness. Now he threatens elves and innocent beasts alike. Krolg will not let one furbolg speak for them all.

sections.title: A Shared Duty
sections.body: Disguised by Dartol's magic, you strike at Ran Bloodtooth and his elite guards. Their deaths can bring justice without stirring more strife among the tribes. A furbolg embittered toward the night elves and an Alliance agent share a purpose against the madness spreading through Ashenvale: cleansing the sacred woodland.

faq.q: Why does Krolg hate the night elves?
faq.answer: Krolg blames the night elves' ancient meddling with dangerous magic for Ashenvale's corruption. He holds them responsible for the land's taint and the tribes' suffering.

Ran Bloodtooth is a corrupt, power-hungry furbolg chieftain camped in the mountains east of Lake Mystral. The dark forces poisoning Ashenvale have driven him mad. His hunger for violence threatens the forest's natural creatures.

faq.q: Why does Krolg want Ran Bloodtooth dead?
faq.answer: Krolg resents the night elves, yet he will not accept the slaughter of innocents. He believes the furbolgs must hold their own to account. Ran's corruption has made him a threat to the whole forest.

faq.q: How can Alliance players speak to Krolg without being attacked?
faq.answer: Dartol's Rod of Transformation lets you take the shape of a furbolg and approach Krolg safely. The enchanted rod came to you during an earlier part of your journey.
Ran Bloodtooth and his guards are encamped in the mountains east of Krolg's refuge near Lake Mystral.

faq.q: How does killing Ran Bloodtooth help cleanse Ashenvale?
aliases: why is bloodtooth part of raenes cleansing
faq.answer: Killing Ran Bloodtooth removes one of the most violent furbolgs empowered by the taint, a danger to every natural creature in the forest. Ashenvale remains tainted, but Krolg sees this as one small step toward its former glory.

angles.text: As a night elf, you may hear Krolg's words as a hard judgment. Local tribes blame kaldorei pride for the ancient sundering and Ashenvale's lingering taint, despite your people's long watch over the forest.
As a druid, you see Ran Bloodtooth as a natural creature lost to demonic corruption and a threat to Ashenvale's balance.
As an Alliance champion, you use Dartol's enchanted rod to approach unseen and confront rogue chieftains deep behind enemy lines.
